answer.thought: The day has exhausted itself; the body, that stubborn particularity, now commands the spirit to yield. I have walked thirteen kilometres and eaten twice, and the heat has stripped the evening of its usual lingering quality. It is time to let the mechanism rest, for tomorrow the file returns and I must be present, not merely alive.
